beats.say: Sonic the Hedgehog fans might expect only official video games, but two tabletop RPGs are completely free.
Polygon says these fan made creations are called Rings and Running Shoes and Sonic Tag Team Heroes.
Sonic Tag Team Heroes features grid based combat and uses dice pools made of d6s and d10s.
Players can choose one of four character types including Speed, Fly, Power or Technique.
Rings and Running Shoes is set in a colourful world of anthropomorphic hedgehogs and echidnas.
There is currently no official Sonic the Hedgehog tabletop RPG made by Sega.
Would you play a fan made tabletop game with your friends this weekend?

facts: Fans can play two free Sonic the Hedgehog inspired tabletop games called Rings and Running Shoes and Sonic Tag Team Heroes.
Sonic Tag Team Heroes is a traditional tabletop game with grid based combat.
Rings and Running Shoes is a Powered by the Apocalypse game set in the world of anthropomorphic hedgehogs and echidnas.
There is no official Sonic the Hedgehog tabletop RPG (yet).
Sonic Tag-Team Heroes uses dice pools comprised of d6s and d10s.
In Sonic Tag-Team Heroes players choose one of four character types: Speed, Fly, Power or Technique.
